title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Pratt Institute-Main
description: Ten nearby restaurant destinations with currently published evening availability, suitable for an under-21 meal or takeout plan after campus work.

cards.title: Emily
cards.subtitle: 919 Fulton Street, Clinton Hill
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s takeout or delivery option when studio work runs long; the official location page publishes extended delivery on select nights.
cards.short_summary: A Fulton Street pizza stop with published late delivery windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Emily’s official Clinton Hill page lists delivery until 9:30 PM Thursdays and 10 PM Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists extended delivery until 9:30 PM Thursday and 10 PM Friday–Saturday; confirm ordering availability before leaving.

cards.title: Aita
cards.subtitle: 132 Greene Avenue, Clinton Hill
cards.notes: Plan a seated dinner or order ahead on Friday or Saturday; the restaurant posts an 11 PM kitchen close for those two nights.
cards.short_summary: A Greene Avenue dinner destination with late weekend kitchen hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Aita’s official site lists Friday and Saturday dinner kitchen hours from 5 PM to 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists kitchen service until 11 PM Friday and Saturday; verify reservations or takeout directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Smør Clinton Hill
cards.subtitle: 26 Putnam Avenue, Clinton Hill
cards.notes: Check the dinner schedule before heading out; its official location page lists service through 10 PM daily and 11 PM Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Putnam Avenue restaurant with dinner hours that extend into late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Smør Clinton Hill’s official page lists dinner from 5 PM to 10 PM daily, with Friday and Saturday dinner until 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dinner until 10 PM daily and 11 PM Friday–Saturday; check the restaurant directly for changes.

cards.title: Bati Ethiopian Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 1057 Fulton Street, Clinton Hill
cards.notes: Make this an evening meal plan and check the posted dinner window; the official site lists service until 10 PM from Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Fulton Street Ethiopian restaurant with a published 10 PM dinner close.
cards.evidence_claim: Bati Ethiopian Kitchen’s official location page lists dinner until 10 PM Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dinner until 10 PM Tuesday–Sunday; the restaurant is closed Monday according to that page.

cards.title: Colonia Verde
cards.subtitle: 219 DeKalb Avenue, Fort Greene
cards.notes: Use the weekend dinner window for a later meal near Fort Greene; the restaurant posts 11 PM closing on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A DeKalb Avenue dinner destination with late weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: Colonia Verde’s official contact page lists dinner until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dinner until 11 PM Friday–Saturday and until 10 PM Sunday–Thursday; check for date-specific changes.

cards.title: Dino
cards.subtitle: 222 DeKalb Avenue, Fort Greene
cards.notes: Save this for a late Thursday-through-Saturday dinner; Dino’s official site posts an 11 PM close on each of those nights.
cards.short_summary: A DeKalb Avenue Northern Italian restaurant with 11 PM late-week hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Dino’s official site lists closing at 11 PM Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11 PM closing Thursday–Saturday; Monday–Wednesday and Sunday are listed until 10 PM.

cards.title: Black Forest Brooklyn — Fort Greene
cards.subtitle: 733 Fulton Street, Fort Greene
cards.notes: For a later Friday or Saturday meal, use the Fort Greene location’s published midnight close and confirm the kitchen’s current service timing directly.
cards.short_summary: A Fulton Street restaurant whose official location hours extend to midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Black Forest Brooklyn’s official site lists its Fort Greene location open until 12 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Black Forest Brooklyn — About and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Fort Greene hours until 12 AM Friday–Saturday; confirm food-service timing separately before a late visit.

cards.title: Mito — Fort Greene
cards.subtitle: 280 Ashland Place, Fort Greene
cards.notes: Use the late-week dinner window if you are already near the cultural district; the restaurant’s official site lists 11 PM closing Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An Ashland Place Japanese restaurant with an official 11 PM weekend close.
cards.evidence_claim: Mito’s official site lists its Fort Greene location open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday hours until 11 PM and other listed days until 10 PM; confirm seating or takeout availability directly.

cards.title: La Caye
cards.subtitle: 35 Lafayette Avenue, Fort Greene
cards.notes: Keep this for a Thursday-through-Saturday dinner plan; La Caye’s official page lists the restaurant open until midnight on those nights.
cards.short_summary: A Lafayette Avenue Haitian restaurant with a published midnight late-week close.
cards.evidence_claim: La Caye’s official site lists Thursday through Saturday opening hours from 4:30 PM to 12 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours until 12 AM Thursday–Saturday; check directly for holiday or private-event changes.

cards.title: Hops Hill
cards.subtitle: 886 Fulton Street, Clinton Hill
cards.notes: Use this Fulton Street food destination only if its current food service is confirmed before you go; its official page posts late overall venue hours.
cards.short_summary: A Clinton Hill food venue with official late-night operating hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Hops Hill’s official site lists its Clinton Hill location open until 4 AM Monday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, and until 2 AM on other listed days.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists late venue hours, but does not separately state kitchen hours; call ahead to confirm current food availability.
